programme.title: A Flying Jatt
programme.desc: Aman, a martial arts teacher, discovers his superpowers when he engages in a fight with Raka, a mercenary. However, Raka is exposed to toxic waste and becomes more powerful and Aman must defeat him.

programme.title: Khamoshiyan
programme.desc: Kabir, a struggling writer, travels to Kashmir for inspiration and starts staying at a mysterious guest house. He falls in love with Meera, the owner of the guesthouse, who harbours a dark secret.

programme.title: Ramaiya Vastavaiya
programme.desc: Ramaiya Vastavaiya is a romantic drama directed by Prabhu Deva. It revolves around Ram (Girish Kumar), a rich and carefree NRI, who falls in love with Sona (Shruti Haasan), a simple village girl. When he proposes marriage, her protective brother (Sonu Sood) challenges him to prove that he can live and work like a farmer before earning her hand. Set in vibrant rural India, the film blends romance, comedy, and family drama with catchy music and traditional values.

programme.title: Pardes
programme.desc: Kishorilal wants an Indian bride for his NRI son, he gets him engaged to Ganga, his friend's daughter. However, she seems to share a deeper bond with Arjun, Kishorilal's foster son.

programme.title: Ek Aur Ek Gyarah
programme.desc: Directed by David Dhawan, this action-comedy features Govinda and Sanjay Dutt as conmen Tara and Sitara. Their escapades lead them to a military household, where they masquerade as patriots, resulting in a series of comedic events. The film combines slapstick humor with action-packed sequences.
